Continue on another device with iCloud

Your progress, stars, achievements and accessibility settings follow your iCloud account on iPhone and iPad. Here is what is shared and what is not.

In short: Claimball lets you pick up where you left off on another device. On iPhone and iPad, your progress, stars, achievements, free-trial state and accessibility settings follow your iCloud account, while the Full Unlock purchase, the Daily Challenge attempt and vibration and sound settings stay on the device. It is still in testing and coming soon to iOS and Android.

Build 7, a TestFlight internal test build, lets you pick up where you left off on another device. It is not released to the public yet.

What follows your iCloud account

On iPhone and iPad, your progress, stars, achievements, the free-trial state and your accessibility settings follow your iCloud account. It works quietly in the background. If iCloud is off or offline, the game simply keeps its own copy on the device.

What stays on the device

Some things are deliberately not shared through iCloud: the Full Unlock purchase (the App Store keeps track of that), the Daily Challenge attempt, and vibration and sound settings.

Careful with purchases

If a purchase is refunded or taken back through Family Sharing, the game locks again. It is careful not to lock by mistake when you are signed out or offline.

What is next

Claimball is still in testing and coming soon to iOS and Android. There is no release date yet.

FAQ

What follows my iCloud account in Claimball?

On iPhone and iPad, your progress, stars, achievements, the free-trial state and your accessibility settings follow your iCloud account. It works quietly in the background.

What is not shared through iCloud?

The Full Unlock purchase (the App Store keeps track of that), the Daily Challenge attempt, and vibration and sound settings stay on the device.

What happens if iCloud is off or offline?

The game simply keeps its own copy on the device.

Is Claimball released yet?

Not yet. It is still in testing and coming soon to iOS and Android, and there is no release date yet.

About the game: Claimball is a casual duel game on a notebook grid for iOS and Android (coming soon, not yet released).
